scope: Every file under the listed crate directories, staged byte for byte from the pinned receipt archives. Cargo.toml files differ from the receipt only in the recorded path strings and the recorded line edits of the one package rename. Comment-only edits that remove references to local records are recorded per file as comment_edits. The coverage crate and the bundle producer are the bundle producer v2 bytes; the coverage limits test reads the lean-v8 files through rewritten include paths. The signed producer crates are tptp-role-bundle-native-v3 (role-v5); the coverage crate stays at revision 2. The signed producer is native v5 (role-v5 with the coverage crate at revision 2). The fang-v8 limits test reads lean-v8/NativeLimits.lean through an include rewrite; crates/ holds only crate directories.
